evals.prompt: Write a Python function parse_duration(text: str) -> int in a file named duration.py. It converts strings like '1h30m' or '45s' into a number of seconds and raises ValueError when the text is not a valid duration. Document it.
evals.expected_output: duration.py containing parse_duration with a Google-style docstring: an imperative one-line summary ending with a period, an Args section for text, a Returns section, and a Raises section for ValueError.
assertions: The docstring starts with a one-line summary in the imperative mood that ends with a period
The docstring has an 'Args:' section that documents the parameter text
The docstring has a 'Raises:' section that mentions ValueError
The docstring does not repeat parameter types that are already in the signature

evals.prompt: Write a token bucket rate limiter as a class RateLimiter in a file named ratelimit.py. The constructor takes rate (tokens per second) and capacity. The public method allow() returns True when a request may proceed. Add documentation for the class and its public API.
evals.expected_output: ratelimit.py containing RateLimiter with a class docstring that documents the constructor parameters under Args, and a Google-style docstring on allow() with a Returns section.
assertions: The class has a docstring with an imperative or descriptive one-line summary that ends with a period
The constructor parameters rate and capacity are documented in an 'Args:' section
allow() has its own docstring with a 'Returns:' section
No docstring uses reStructuredText fields such as ':param' or ':returns:'

evals.prompt: Write a generator function chunked(items: list, size: int) in a file named chunks.py that yields successive lists of at most size items, and raises ValueError when size is smaller than 1. Add a docstring.
evals.expected_output: chunks.py containing chunked with a Google-style docstring that uses Yields instead of Returns and documents ValueError under Raises.
assertions: The docstring has an 'Args:' section that documents items and size
The docstring has a 'Yields:' section instead of a 'Returns:' section
The docstring has a 'Raises:' section that mentions ValueError
The first line of the docstring is an imperative one-line summary ending with a period
